runtime_prompt_en:
A winter fashion photograph shows a woman guided by the attached portrait, wearing a layered winter outfit at a small neighborhood cinema just after a snowfall. Use the attached portrait as a guide to visible face and hair appearance: soft oval facial proportions, brown eyes, a chin-length straight dark bob and lightly separated wispy bangs. She has just replaced the poster in a low glass display case beside the entrance; a discarded curled paper sheet and an empty poster tube lie together on the stone step. The new poster is a simple red and cream graphic behind glass. Her right gloved hand presses the small brass latch closed at waist height while her left gloved hand steadies the case's lower frame. The fingers curl around the frame edge and the other wrist aligns naturally with the latch, so the purpose and the finishing moment are clear. She stands comfortably beside the case with both feet on the broad dry center of the step, her right foot slightly forward and her shoulders turned a little toward the display. Her arms stay in front of her torso with bent elbows, and the two forearms and hands remain separately traceable. Her attentive gaze follows the latch, lips softly parted and shoulders relaxed; warm entrance light grazes her cheek and lends a quiet inviting quality to the absorbed expression. Her stone-gray wool coat is unfastened, its long front panels falling to either side of a charcoal above-knee pleated tweed skirt. A fitted cream rib-knit turtleneck fills the open upper coat; its collar rises above the scarf at the chin. The gray coat's open lapels and hanging panels make a soft frame around the cream rib-knit torso, whose collar, sleeve cuffs and lower hem belong to a separate sweater. An ivory knitted scarf loops around her lower neck, and two separate fringed ends hang down outside the coat fronts, leaving the central sweater and skirt opening readable. Each ivory scarf tail rests on a gray coat panel; knitted side edges and loose tassels remain clearly bounded against the felted wool. Burgundy leather full-finger gloves cover both hands. Their wrist cuffs extend beneath the cream sweater cuffs, which emerge from the gray coat sleeves as three distinct successive edges. Across both exposed leg intervals, from the tweed skirt edge to the chestnut boot rims, dark opaque rib-knit tights form the outermost uninterrupted cloth surface. Both chestnut leather knee-high boots have fitted shafts ending just below the knees, almond toes, low block heels and distinct outsoles. Below each chestnut boot, a thick dark sole forms a broad supporting slab under both the toe-bearing forefoot and the low block heel. The front opening of the coat leaves the skirt hem, tights and boot rims visible together. Frame her from the top of the hair to the boot soles in a vertical, three-quarter frontal photograph, with the low case beside her rather than across her body. A normal lens from chest height keeps the face, wrists and leg junctions legible at one natural scale. Warm light from the cinema doorway meets cool blue snow along the edge of the step; the softly focused interior beyond the glass suggests where she will go next. Preserve visible knit ribs, wool fuzz, leather creases and grounded shadows, with an inhabited observational fashion mood.
